requirements.text: The library management system shall maintain a maximum borrowing limit of 5 books per member to ensure responsible borrowing.
The library management system shall implement a unified authentication process that integrates user authentication and access control for security.
The library management system shall automatically notify members of overdue books via email to promote responsibility.
The library management system shall process book returns within 1 second to maintain high throughput.
The library management system shall log all borrowing transactions for auditability purposes.
The library management system shall allow members to search for books with a response time of under 2 seconds.
The library management system shall track real-time inventory status of all books.
The library management system shall implement a tracking system for energy consumption related to borrowing operations.
The library management system shall provide a mechanism to report and manage overdue books securely.
The library management system shall implement a feedback mechanism for members to report issues regarding fairness in library services.
The library management system shall provide an annual report on usage statistics to ensure transparency in library operations.
